source_note: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位，Fejer核是逼近单位元
english_source_note: Dirichlet Kernels Fail, Fejer Kernels Approximate Identity
callout_id: Dirichlet核不是逼近单位,Fejer核是逼近单位元#3
statement_en: Let $a_n:=(-1)^n$. Then its partial sums are $$S_n:=\begin{cases}1&n\text{ is even}\\0&n\text{ is odd}\end{cases}$$ so $S_n$ does not converge. However, this sequence is Cesaro summable, because $$\sigma_N:=\frac{S_0+\cdots+S_{N-1}}{N}=\frac{\lfloor\frac{N}{2}+1\rfloor}{N}$$ and its limit is $\frac{1}{2}$.
callout_body: $a_n:=(-1)^n$，那么其部分和$$S_n:=\begin{cases}1&n\text{是偶数}\\0&n\text{是奇数}\end{cases}$$是不存在极限的。但是这个序列确实Cesaro可和的，因为$$\sigma_N:=\frac{S_0+\cdots+S_{N-1}}{N}=\frac{\lfloor\frac{N}{2}+1\rfloor}{N}$$其极限为$\frac{1}{2}$。
